entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I assist you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide the order number or the email address associated with your account?
The email is mark.harrison@email.com. It was a helmet.

Thank you, Mr. Harrison. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see it. I'd like to thank you for being a VeloFit VIP member. I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet placed 45 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the color. It's not what I wanted.
I understand completely. Sometimes the shades can look different online. And just to confirm, there are no issues with the fit or any of the safety features?
No, it's fine. It's just the color.
Okay. And is the original box unopened, or has the item been handled?
Of course I opened it. How else would I see the color? The box is open, the helmet is untouched. Whatever.

Not a problem at all, Mr. Harrison. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day window for a standard return. I can approve this for you right now and email you a prepaid return label.

I've just sent it. You should receive it in the next few minutes. As soon as we receive the item, we will process a full refund. Also, as a small thank you for your loyalty as a VIP customer, I've added a $15 credit to your account for a future purchase. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
